attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Pennsylvania state income tax. Flat 3.07% rate (72 P.S. § 7302, 2025) on PA taxable income across 8 classes. PA has NO standard deduction and NO personal exemption. For the simple-return case this implementation treats pa_total_income as AGI (W-2 wages dominate); retirement income (pensions, SS, IRA) is excluded by federal-AGI definitions for most filers, and a richer 8-class split is a follow-up. Writes result.pa_total_income, result.pa_tax, and result.pa_state_tax.

initial_action.action_comment: Reset PA tax fields and log calculation start
initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.pa_tax = 0; set result.pa_state_tax = 0; set result.pa_total_income = 0; add " Pennsylvania Tax Calculation (Form PA-40) - flat 3.07%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.pa_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.pa_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.pa_total_income xdef " Pennsylvania Tax Calculation (Form PA-40) - flat 3.07%" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.pa_tax xdef 0.0 /result.pa_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.pa_total_income xdef " Pennsylvania Tax Calculation (Form PA-40) — flat 3.07%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (PA has no filing-status differences in rate/deduction)

action_details.action_comment: PA total income = AGI (simple); tax = total_income × 3.07%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.pa_total_income = the maximum of result.agi and 0.0; set result.pa_tax = result.pa_total_income * pa_tax_rate; set result.pa_state_tax = result.pa_tax; add " PA total income: $" + result.pa_total_income to job.audit_trail; add " PA state tax (3.07%): $" + result.pa_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 fmax cvd /result.pa_total_income xdef result.pa_total_income pa_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.pa_tax xdef result.pa_tax cvd /result.pa_state_tax xdef " PA total income: $" result.pa_total_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " PA state tax (3.07%): $" result.pa_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "PA flat tax per 72 P.S. § 7302, 3.07% rate, no deductions"
